text: - Training across a wide spectrum of repetition ranges (1 to 20+) is recommended to ensure complete whole-muscle development. From an efficiency standpoint, there is merit to focusing on a medium-repetition range (6RM to 12RM) and devoting specific training cycles or sessions to lower- and higher-repetition training.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 4: Role of Resistance Training Variables in Hypertrophy
